purpose: Scientific train-to-heldout solver preference diagnosis; not competitive new selector training
labels: Original raw_label FP64 costs, unchanged native local winner; names/order from current registry and result filenames, not README
gap: (solver cost - original full native pool minimum) / minimum; CSV gap/advantage numbers in percent or percentage points
tie_break: first registry position, without modifying native winner

hierarchy: exact training size shrunk to bin
priors.global_sbs: training minimum mean absolute cost, distinct from training minimum mean relative gap

regions: Same frozen regions have BOTH majority and minmeanrelativegap actions; extra label-free train-median feature x size-bin regions

feature_only_regions.threshold: global training input median; no label threshold selection

features.absent_globals: presence flag and zero; no inferred backhaul class/depot deadline

geometry.sampling: smallest deterministic uint64 coordinate hashes with raw-attribute tie breaks; no instance IDs
geometry.caution: nn1/nn8 are subset nearest distances for sampled instances, not estimates of exact full-set nearest neighbors

features.reused_cache: OVRPTW r49 75-field input statistics if matching existing source provenance; all others computed/cached here
features.CVRPLIB: Remove first depot from loc only if zero demand and exactly matching depot; keep raw_node_counts; costs/winners unchanged

uncertainty.mean_ci: two-sided Student-t 95%; Wilson native win-rate CI
uncertainty.tree_train_ci: adaptive and descriptive, not honest estimation; feature-only regions avoid target-selected thresholds
uncertainty.reference_pair: top two native winner frequencies in TRAIN; registry tie break
uncertainty.simultaneous: Bonferroni Student-t intervals across conservative maximum val/test region families; descriptive iid-instance assumption
uncertainty.multiplicity_caution: No p-value search; nominal mean CIs also retained. Multiple routing variants may share base instances, so macro uncertainty is not computed as independent instances.

pairs: All unordered pairs in each actual native pool, not only ReLD; train-top3 and large train expected-gap pairs flagged, never prune coverage
independence: Analytic expected native accuracy and relative gap of independent draws from train-smoothed same-region distribution; no duplicated model/error/permutation statistics
hindsight: Heldout best constant mean relative gap is an evaluation-label diagnostic lower reference among constants ONLY, not a fitted deployable policy or lower bound for region policies
feature_shift: Signed mean difference / pooled population SD; empirical two-sample ECDF KS distance; per-feature and per-instance train min/max exceedance. No KS p-values.

arrays.feature_cache: feature_cache/{problem}_{split}.npz: X FP64[N,F], names, sizes, indices, split, raw_node_counts, geometry_sample_size
arrays.memberships: memberships/{problem}_{split}.npz: indices,sizes,split,size_bin,winner_tree_leaf,gap_tree_leaf,predeclared_feature_quantile,geometry_quantile plus demand/TW regions when available
arrays.truth: native local registry winner, identical to winner
arrays.logits_majority: log smoothed train probabilities; argmax unchanged
arrays.logits_mean_gap: negative smoothed mean relative gaps, fractional units

limits: Historical solver costs/contracts are taken as provided, not recertified.
No neural selector training, GPU, tuning, solver reruns, commits, or R70 residual contrast here.
Failure of these shallow fixed diagnostics does not demonstrate feature insufficiency or conditional independence.
LIB is an out-of-distribution supplemental holdout, never merged into the 18-task macro.
Mean advantage sign alone is not certainty; support and empirical intervals are reported.
